lines.trans: Sasha, did you pass my important request to the chef?
Yes, Viktoriya Sergeyevna, I told him everything.
Did you say that I asked for the new menu?
Yes, I personally reminded the chef about this.
And what was his answer to that?
He only loudly shouted at the entire kitchen.
I see, he again is completely not listening to me.
The chef has been very angry since this morning.
We urgently need to update the list of our dishes.
Guests in the dining room are already asking for new desserts.
I will go myself right now and talk to him.
Be very careful, the chef is in a bad mood.
That is fine, order in the restaurant is more important than his whims!

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.

meanings.note: поставить громко = to put a phone on speaker

examples.text: Не говорите так громко, дети спят.
examples.trans: Don't speak so loudly, the children are asleep.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.trans: Three rooms and a big kitchen.

examples.text: Аникеев лично сюда приезжал, и что?
examples.trans: Anikeev came here in person, and what?

meanings.note: on a phone or in a restaurant; indeclinable

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.
Lyosha, remind us, what is this?
He reminded his friend about the meeting.

examples.text: Вот с таким настроением и иди к Аникееву.
examples.trans: Go to Anikeev in just that mood.
I am in a good mood today.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
as a reply on its own

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: Thank you for the honest answer.

передать.gloss: to pass on, to hand over

meanings.en: to pass on, to hand over, to give

examples.trans: Please pass on my regards to your mum.

meanings.en: to have a talk, to speak (with someone)

meanings.note: по порядку = in order; всё в порядке = everything is fine

examples.trans: Now let's go through everything in order.

meanings.note: просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness
у нас к вам просьба = we have a request for you

examples.trans: We have a request for you.

examples.text: У меня к тебе маленькая просьба.
examples.trans: I have a small favour to ask of you.

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.

meanings.note: the imperative 'слушай' starts a sentence, like 'look, ...'

examples.text: Совершенно верно, я мэр этого города.
examples.trans: Quite right, I am the mayor of this town.

meanings.en: urgently, right away; predicative: it is urgent

examples.trans: I need to make a phone call urgently.
